senses.en: (also 'alleyway') a narrow street between or behind buildings, not usually used by cars
examples: A narrow [[alley]] led up between the houses to the main street.

senses.en: the way in which the parts of sth. such as the page of a book, a garden, or a building are arranged
examples: All the flats in the building have the same [[layout]].

senses.en: (BrE neighbourhood) a district or an area of a town
examples: Jessica and Jason grew up in the same [[neighborhood]] of Boston.

senses.en: the state of feeling excited
examples: The children were filled with [[excitement]] at the thought of visiting Disneyland.

senses.zh: 精神饱满的；生气勃勃的；有决心的
senses.en: having energy and determination
examples: At the end of the day, the usually cheerful and [[spirited]] girl was worn out.

senses.en: (~ of) very typical of a particular thing or of sb.'s character
examples: Personality is often defined as an individual's [[characteristic]] way of thinking, feeling, and behaving.

senses.zh: 使钦佩；使留下深刻印象
senses.en: make sb. feel admiration and respect
examples: None of the people I've interviewed so far has [[impressed]] me.

senses.en: be the thing that makes sb. / sth. different or special
examples: The factor that [[distinguishes]] this company from its competitors is customer service.

senses.en: recognize and understand the difference between two or more things or people
examples: At what age are children able to [[distinguish]] between right and wrong?

senses.en: the way in which two facts, ideas, events, people, etc. are related to each other, and one is affected or caused by the other
examples: There is a [[connection]] between pollution and the death of trees.

senses.en: A group of people who live together and who share the work and their possessions
examples: She went to California and joined a [[commune]].

senses.zh: （为同一群体所）共有的，共用的，共享的
senses.en: shared by a group of people or animals, esp. a group who live together
examples: As a student he tried [[communal]] living for a few years.

senses.en: having sth. as part of a group or set
examples: I've got three days' holiday [[including]] New Year's Day.

senses.en: sb. from the western part of the world
examples: What is difficult for [[Westerners]] to understand is the real meaning of these cultural customs.

senses.en: the time at the beginning of the day when light first appears
examples: I don't think he went to sleep until [[dawn]].

senses.en: (only before noun) existing, happening, or used outside, not inside a building
examples: I love [[outdoor]] activities such as walking and camping.

senses.en: happy, or behaving in a way that shows you are happy
examples: Before the accident he had been [[cheerful]] and confident.

senses.en: sb. who tries to find a suitable partner for sb. else to marry
examples: Ours, after all, was not a marriage arranged by a [[matchmaker]] or by our parents.

senses.en: (BrE vendor) sb. who sells things, esp. on the street
examples: He bought a copy from a newspaper [[vender]].

senses.en: (AmE) (~ up ∕ along ∕ down, etc.) ride a bicycle
examples: Andrew [[pedaled]] up the road toward the town center.

senses.en: of or being a distinctive, identifying feature or characteristic
examples: She was about to burst into her [[trademark]] laughter when her mom silenced her.

senses.en: a special name, sign, or word that is marked on a product to show that it is made by a particular company, that cannot be used by any other company
examples: The big letter "M" is McDonald's best-known [[trademark]].

senses.en: take sb's attention away from sth. by making them look at or listen to sth. else
examples: Try not to [[distract]] the other students.

senses.zh: 分散注意力的；使人分心的
senses.en: preventing you from concentrating on sth.
examples: I find it too [[distracting]] to work with the television on.

senses.en: (of sounds) very high
examples: I could hear [[high-pitched]] laughter coming from the girls' bedroom.

senses.en: sb. who buys and sells a particular product
examples: She bought the painting from a Swiss art [[dealer]] two months ago.

senses.zh: （嗓音或乐器的）音域，声区，音区
senses.en: the range of musical notes that sb.'s voice or a musical instrument can reach
examples: Singers have to learn how to sing in the upper [[register]].

senses.en: put sb.'s / sth.'s name on an official list
examples: How many students have [[registered]] for English classes this semester?

senses.en: make sth. have a sharper edge or point, or become sharper
examples: Anne [[sharpened]] her pencil and got out her homework.

senses.en: a person or device that makes sth. sharp
examples: You can buy the best pencil [[sharpeners]] at low prices in our store.

senses.zh: 硬物撞击声；咔哒声；啪嗒声
senses.en: the short loud sound of one hard object hitting against another
examples: I heard the [[clack]] of high heels as she crossed the yard.

senses.en: make sb. feel calmer and less anxious, upset, or angry
examples: Lucia [[soothed]] the baby by rocking him in her arms.

senses.en: making you feel calm and less nervous, worried, or upset
examples: My mother had a gentle, [[soothing]] voice.

senses.en: sth. that makes you notice, remember, or think about sth.
examples: The town wanted to forget the war but the destroyed bridge was a painful [[reminder]].

senses.en: (~ with) full of people moving about in a busy way
examples: The flower market was [[bustling]] with shoppers.

senses.en: sb.'s mind, or their deepest feelings, which control their attitudes and behavior
examples: She knew, at some deep level of her [[psyche]], that what she was doing was wrong.

senses.en: say hello to sb. or welcome them
examples: She [[greeted]] each of the guests as they came through the door.

senses.en: a ball of air or gas in liquid
examples: When water boils, [[bubbles]] rise to the surface.

senses.en: give special importance to sth.
examples: The report [[emphasizes]] the importance of improving safety standards.

senses.en: energy and enthusiasm to make new things happen or to make things succeed
examples: People responded positively to Ruth's cheerfulness and [[dynamism]].

senses.en: many times
examples: Sam was [[repeatedly]] warned not to work so hard.

senses.zh: 同事；同僚（尤为专业人士所用）
senses.en: sb. you work with — used esp. by professional people
examples: She discussed the idea with some of her [[colleagues]].

senses.en: (fml.) refuse politely to accept or to do sth.
examples: The Prime Minister was asked for his opinion but he [[declined]] to comment.

senses.en: decrease in quantity or importance
examples: Spending on information technology has started to [[decline]] in recent years.

senses.en: a decrease in the quality, quantity, or importance of sth.
examples: There has been a [[decline]] in the size of families.

senses.zh: （喝茶、咖啡等用的有柄的）大杯，马克杯
senses.en: a tall cup used for drinking tea, coffee, etc.
examples: Jake had a quick breakfast and a [[mug]] of coffee in the morning.

senses.en: happen or exist at the same time as sth. else
examples: The disease is [[accompanied]] by headache and fever.

senses.en: go somewhere with sb.
examples: Children under 14 must be [[accompanied]] by an adult in these activities.

senses.en: an act of saying or showing that you will not do, give, or accept sth.
examples: His [[refusal]] to discuss the matter made me angry.

senses.en: sth. that you say or do, often sth. small, to show how you feel about sb. / sth.
examples: They sent me some flowers as a [[gesture]] of goodwill.

senses.zh: （表达意思或感觉的）手势，姿势
senses.en: a movement of part of your body, esp. your hands or head, to show what you mean or how you feel
examples: Jim raised his hands in a despairing [[gesture]].

senses.en: (fml.) a hot or cold drink
examples: Beer is the most popular alcoholic [[beverage]].

senses.en: a greater interest in or desire for sb. / sth. than sb. / sth. else
examples: Many people expressed a strong [[preference]] for the original plan.

senses.en: (only before noun) continuing or existing all through your life
examples: She first visited Ireland when she was 10, and developed a [[lifelong]] interest in the country.

senses.zh: （争论、分歧等）激烈而不愉快的，充满愤怒与仇恨的
senses.en: (of arguments, disagreements, etc.) very serious and unpleasant, with a lot of anger and hatred involved
examples: The couple had a [[bitter]] quarrel over the division of labor.

senses.zh: 愤愤不平的；充满怨恨的
senses.en: feeling angry, jealous, and upset because you think you have been treated unfairly
examples: I feel [[bitter]] about his behavior.

senses.zh: 姻亲（尤指公婆或岳父母）
senses.en: (infml.) your relatives by marriage, esp. the father and mother of your husband or wife
examples: We lived with my [[in-laws]] until we had enough money to buy a house of our own.

senses.zh: 好客的；殷勤的；热情友好的
senses.en: friendly, welcoming, and generous to visitors
examples: The local people were very kind and [[hospitable]].

senses.zh: 尽责的；忠诚的；顺从的；恭敬的
senses.en: doing what you are expected to do and behaving in a loyal and obedient way
examples: His [[dutiful]] secretary was always there to answer her boss' call when he needed her.

senses.en: cook sth. slowly, or allow sth. to cook slowly, in liquid in a closed dish
examples: The meat needs to [[stew]] for two hours.

senses.zh: 炖的菜；煨的菜（有肉和蔬菜）
senses.en: a dish of meat and vegetables cooked slowly in liquid in a container that has a lid
examples: I'm making a [[stew]] for lunch.

senses.zh: （因胜利或成功而）洋洋得意地，耀武扬威地
senses.en: in a state of showing pleasure and pride because of a victory or success
examples: "I've got a job," she announced [[triumphantly]].

senses.en: (~ at / up / down, etc.) quickly look at sb. / sth.
examples: The man [[glanced]] nervously at his watch.

senses.en: containing a lot of milk
examples: Water, fruit juice, and hot [[milky]] drinks are offered on planes.

senses.en: a short pointed knife used as a weapon
used when you are giving your opinion or stating what is important about a situation
examples: [[Basically]], we're looking for someone who can work three afternoons a week.

senses.en: a person who is not accepted as a member of a society, group, etc.
examples: I'm an [[outsider]], the only foreign woman in the group.

senses.en: if different people or organizations unite, or if sth. unites them, they join together in order to achieve sth.
examples: We will [[unite]] in fighting crime.

senses.zh: （人或群体）和谐的，一致的，团结的
senses.en: (of people or groups) in agreement and working together
examples: We need to become a more [[united]] team.

senses.zh: 很重要的；神圣的；深受尊重的
senses.en: very important or greatly respected
examples: Few things were [[sacred]] to Henry, but local history was one of them.

senses.en: relating to a god or religion
examples: Certain animals were considered [[sacred]].

senses.en: the room, building, etc. where you work
examples: How do you keep your personal problems out of the [[workplace]]?

senses.en: (infml.) quickly put sth. somewhere, usu. for a short time
examples: She took out a piece of chewing gum (口香糖)and [[popped]] it in her mouth.

senses.zh: （突然或出人意料地）蹦出，离开，脱落
senses.en: come suddenly or unexpectedly out of or away from sth.
examples: The top button [[popped]] off my shirt.

senses.zh: 使人不愉快的；不合意的；讨厌的
senses.en: not pleasant or enjoyable
examples: Undercooked potatoes taste [[unpleasant]] and can be harmful.

senses.en: (esp. BrE) an amount of tea made at one time
examples: Nothing beats the taste of a fresh [[brew]] made from Carlisle Tea's fine quality loose-leaf teas.

senses.zh: 冗长的；啰唆的；单调乏味的；令人厌烦的
senses.en: lasting or taking too long and not interesting
examples: We had to listen to the [[tedious]] details of his presentation.

senses.en: the act of recording information in a computer, book, etc.
examples: The program is used to describe the [[entry]] of data into the network.

senses.en: the act of going into sth.
examples: It was dark and their [[entry]] into the camp had gone unnoticed.

senses.zh: （习惯、态度等）根深蒂固的，日久难改的
senses.en: (~ in) (of a habit, attitude, etc.) that has existed for a long time and is therefore difficult to change
examples: The idea of doing our duty is deeply [[ingrained]] in most people.

senses.zh: （运或送食物、饮料的）手推车，台车
senses.en: (AmE cart) a small table on very small wheels, used for carrying or serving food or drink
(fml.) eat or drink sth.
examples: In order to survive, human beings need to [[consume]] food and water.

senses.en: use time, energy, goods, etc.
examples: A smaller car will [[consume]] less fuel.

senses.en: ask a lot of people the same questions in order to find out what they think about a subject
examples: Over 50% of those [[polled]] were against the proposed military action.

senses.en: almost
examples: This report says [[more or less]] the same thing as the previous one.

senses.en: put warm clothes on sb. or yourself because it is cold
examples: You'll have to [[bundle up]]; it's cold outside.

senses.en: move or get somewhere
examples: The team slowly [[made their way]] back to the base camp.

senses.en: give sth. to sb. else, esp. after receiving it or using it yourself
examples: She said she'd [[pass]] the message [[on]] to the other students.

senses.en: find sb. / sth. that is difficult to find by searching or looking for information in several different places
examples: The police have so far failed to [[track down]] the attacker.

senses.zh: 心里已有某人 / 某事物（作为···的目标选项）
senses.en: have an idea about who or what you want for a particular purpose
examples: [[Have]] you got any particular color [[in mind]] for the bedroom?

senses.en: spend a lot of time with sb.
examples: The people I used to [[hang around with]] were much older than me.

senses.en: make sb. / sth. lively or interesting
examples: With these pictures I hope to [[bring]] the room [[to life]].

english: drive sb. crazy / nuts / mad / insane

senses.en: make sb. feel very annoyed
examples: Would you stop that humming? You're [[driving]] me [[crazy]]!

senses.en: (of a remark, etc.) have a strong effect on sb., in a way that makes them realize what the true facts of a situation are
examples: She saw the emotion in her father's face and knew her words had [[hit home]].

english: take it upon / on oneself (to do sth.)

senses.zh: 擅自做主做某事；自作主张做某事
senses.en: (fml.) decide to do sth. without getting sb.'s permission or approval first
examples: He [[took it upon himself]] to personally thank each person at the meeting.

senses.zh: （在不同情况下）继续存在，保持下去
senses.en: continue to exist in a different situation
examples: Attitudes learned at home [[carry over]] into the playground.

senses.en: (BrE, spoken) quickly turn on a piece of electrical equipment
examples: [[Pop on]] the stove with a loose fitting lid to allow steam to escape.

senses.zh: 紫禁城（中国明清两代的皇家宫殿）
白金汉宫（英国王室官邸，位于伦敦）
